system.description:
A Data Leaking creature gains vulnerability to one damage type of the inflictors choice.

A Data Leaking Creature increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +8.

Once the affected creatures takes damage of the type, they gained vulnerability to as a result of this condition, they can make a Constitution saving throw vs the Genwa’s highest jutsu save DC. On a success, this condition is dispelled.
system.summary: Vulnerable to a damage type the Genwa chooses; jutsu cost +8; taking that damage allows a Constitution save to dispel it.

rules.text: Add the chosen vulnerability on the creature. When it takes that damage type it makes a Constitution save against the Genwa's highest jutsu save DC; a success dispels this.
